messages:
zoe: T-minus 70m into the Thursday change window. Quick sync: freeze exemptions, emergency rollback steps, and quiet-window durations. Any last blockers?
ben: +1. Two asks: clarify who can approve an emergency unfreeze and confirm pinning for the model/runtime.
claire: emergency unfreeze needs EngLead + SRE on-call ack in thread. Pin plan: runtime=release-20260330, model=v1.5.1. Fallbacks allowed to runtime release-20260310 and model v1.5.0.
deploy-bot: release queued: release-id=eu-thurs-slice-2026-04-15-01. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Logs: https://logs.redwood/ci/release/eu-thurs-slice-2026-04-15-01
ops-bot: note: network flapping threshold set to 0.4% packet loss for 3m. Will escalate to paging if hit.
ben: rollback triggers I want: 1) user-facing errors >=0.8% for 5m, 2) p95 >2s sustained for 5m, 3) any customer SLA breach report.
zoe: add correlated region failures (>=2 regions 5xx) or repo smoke-test regressions. Manual abort channel: #release-hotline.
claire: enable verbose canary logs for reranker and prefix-cache keys only. Keep full perf sampling off.
deploy-bot: canary 5% applied. Health checks running.
(small pause)
deploy-bot: after 6m: errors 0.01%, p95 720ms, canary auto-pass. Ramping to 20% per plan.
ops-bot: GPU temps nominal. Minor mem jitter on eu-west-3b, monitoring.
ben: migration zap job completed in staging; production migration scheduled during ramp. Claire, confirm migration verification window?
claire: will run sampled verification at 20% and post result. Need green within 40m or we hold.
zoe: final checklist: pins set ✅ canary started ✅ migration check pending ✅ rollback triggers defined ✅. Proceeding unless aborts.
deploy-bot: ramping to 20%. Metrics stream: https://dash.redwood/canary/eu-thurs-slice-2026-04-15-01
ben: pro tip: watch cold-start tail at 40%-60% ramp; embedder latency can spike there.
ops-bot: alerting: escalate to paging if errors >1% for 3m or p95 >3s for 5m.
zoe: GO from me. Posting final go note to the release ticket and starting quiet-window on reach of 100%. Thanks all.
